name: Friendship Seven
about: Friendship Seven (1962 GAM 1), a crewed vehicle (Mercury MA), launched 1962 Feb 20. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1962 Feb 20), held fixed
